queryAndRequestOutcome: Separate English and Burmese discovery queries were performed. Official first-party references identified the Settlement and Land Records Department (SLRD), Survey Department, Myanmar National Portal, and One Map Myanmar development activity. SLRD returned HTTP 403 to an ordinary TLS-verified GET from this environment; Survey Department timed out on ordinary TLS-verified GET; Myanmar National Portal failed local certificate verification, and no certificate exception was used. Search-result pages were readable, but no current public city-specific parcel viewer/API, schema, CRS, or bounded anonymous ID-plus-geometry response for Mawlamyinegyunn was available. No login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, credential, private token, unsafe field, or coordinate shift was used.
